activity.meditation.desc: Calm the mind to sharpen insight and regain some stamina.
activity.fishing.desc: Fish by the stream for food and a few coins.
activity.herb_gathering.desc: Search the hills for herbs and learn along the way.
activity.mining.desc: Work the veins: risk and reward.
activity.hunting.desc: Track game for food and pelts.
activity.cooking.desc: Turn ingredients into a hot meal that restores stamina.
activity.music.desc: Play a tune to steady the spirit and win over listeners.
activity.chess.desc: Play a match to hone insight and earn a strategy token.
activity.social_visit.desc: Call on a friend to deepen your bond.

event.day3_recruit.body: A passing traveler has noticed your training and seems eager to meet you.
activity.technique_practice.opt.risky.de: Fast progress; failure costs extra stamina.
activity.fishing.opt.rapids.desc: Rich catch; a miss tires you.
activity.herb_gathering.opt.cliff.desc: Rare herbs; a slip costs stamina.
activity.mining.opt.deep.desc: Big yield; a cave-in drains you.
activity.hunting.opt.boar.desc: Plenty of food; a miss hurts.
activity.music.opt.for_shen.desc: Deepens your bond with Shen Qinghe.
activity.music.opt.for_lu.desc: Deepens your bond with Lu Chenzhou.
activity.social_visit.opt.chat_bai.desc: Strengthens your bond with Bai Yan.
activity.social_visit.opt.gift_bai.desc: Costs coins; a much bigger bond.
activity.social_visit.opt.chat_shen.desc: Strengthens your bond with Shen Qinghe.
activity.social_visit.opt.chat_lu.desc: Strengthens your bond with Lu Chenzhou.
companion.shen_qinghe.bio: A herbalist who heals and supports. Values compassion and knowledge.
companion.lu_chenzhou.bio: A courier and mobile striker. Values independence and courage.
companion.bai_yan.bio: A former academy student who controls the field. Values discipline and learning.
ability.calming_incense.desc: Removes one negative status from an ally.
ability.gentle_hands.desc: Bond ability (once per battle, free): heal an ally within 2 for 10 HP and cleanse.
ability.swift_dash.desc: Move fast and strike one enemy.
ability.ambush_strike.desc: Strike from behind for more damage.
ability.couriers_shortcut.desc: Bond ability (once per battle, free): +3 movement this turn.
ability.counter_notes.desc: Anticipate an attack and weaken its damage.
ability.margin_notes.desc: Bond ability (once per battle, free): mark a foe within 3, weakening it and sapping its resolve.
party.title: Companions
recruit.title: Will {name} join you?
recruit.body_ready: {name} thinks well of you and is willing to travel with you.
recruit.body_refuse: {name} is still watching how you act. ({list})
exploration.bamboo_pass.start.text: Morning mist hangs over Bamboo Pass. The path splits three ways: an old road, a stream, and a ridge trail.
exploration.bamboo_pass.old_road.text: Deep wheel ruts mark the old road. A traveling courier rests by the roadside, sizing you up. Farther on, muddy footprints crisscross the path.
You read the prints: armed men, heading for a camp.
The prints tangle and you circle back, tired.
exploration.bamboo_pass.courier.text: The courier introduces himself as Lu Chenzhou. He thinks you walk too slowly, but he is willing to talk.
exploration.bamboo_pass.stream.text: The stream runs clear. Something glints between the stones.
exploration.bamboo_pass.stream.search.su: Between the stones: half a water-stained letter and some herbs.
exploration.bamboo_pass.stream.search.fa: You slip into the stream and lose some strength.
exploration.bamboo_pass.ridge.text: The ridge is steep and windy. You haul yourself up and the valley opens below.
exploration.bamboo_pass.lookout.text: A camp hides in the valley below. A scholar-like young man copies notes at the cliff edge: Bai Yan.
exploration.bamboo_pass.camp_edge.text: You creep to the camp's edge. A few guards lounge against the stakes; supplies are stacked inside.
You find a supply ledger and pocket some loose silver.
The guards spot you and you flee. (The skirmish arrives in a later milestone.)
exploration.bamboo_pass.gate.text: At the pass's end stands an old gate, its lintel carved with faded marks.
exploration.bamboo_pass.end_plain.text: You pass the gate safely and the trek ends. Something in these hills is not finished yet.
exploration.bamboo_pass.end_wise.text: You read the marks: they point to someone behind the camp. You leave the pass carrying that secret.
exploration.bamboo_pass.desc: Mist-bound Bamboo Pass: three paths, each with its own encounters and clues.
explore.title: {name}
explore.ended: The trek is over and used one slot.
combat.scenario.rescue_battle.objective: Protect the villager for five rounds, or defeat every enemy.
combat.scenario.final_crisis.objective: Defeat the bandit leader, or hold out until round eight.
combat.ui.title: Battle: {name}
combat.outcome.survived: You held out to the end.
combat.log.damage_hazard: {unit} is hurt by the terrain: HP -{amount}.
story.day1_intro.n1: Welcome to Jade Valley, young one. Bandits have their eyes on the pass, and we must get ready this month.
story.day1_intro.n2: Each week has two slots. Pick an activity; it costs stamina, and when you run low, rest.
story.day1_intro.n3: Choose your path of cultivation first. Every bit of training makes you stronger and changes how others see you.
story.day2_path.choose: A few days have passed. Time to choose your path.
story.day2_path.choose.fist: Follow The Way of the Mystic Fist
story.day2_path.choose.sword: Follow The Way of the Green Blade
story.day2_path.choose.rain: Follow The Way of Listening Rain
story.day2_path.choose.later: Let me think a little longer
story.day2_path.chosen: Your path is set. Each practice takes it deeper.
story.day2_path.done: You have already chosen your path. Good. Keep sharpening it.
story.day4_battle.n1: At dawn a villager stumbles into the valley: bandit scouts are raiding the foot of the mountain!
story.day4_battle.n2: Please, they are taking the whole village's food!
story.day4_battle.n2.together: Ask your companion to come along
story.day4_win.n1: Thank you! Without you the whole village would be lost.
story.day4_win.n2: The bandits will soon learn someone defends the valley. Use the next two weeks well.
story.day4_lose.n1: You were forced to retreat. The villagers are shaken and some are hurt.
story.day4_lose.n2: Do not lose heart. Defeat teaches too, but time is short.
story.day5_faction.n1: Three parties visit within the same week, each hoping you will stand with them.
story.day5_faction.n2: Your choice gives the valley something to lean on. Choose carefully.
story.day5_faction.n2.pavilion: Stand with the Herb Pavilion (Shen Qinghe)
story.day5_faction.n2.couriers: Stand with the Courier Road (Lu Chenzhou)
story.day5_faction.n2.scribes: Stand with the Scribes' Study (Bai Yan)
story.day6_prepare.n1: The bandit chief arrives soon. Prepare this week, or scout Bamboo Pass if you like. Exploring is optional.
story.day7_crisis.n1: The month is nearly over. The bandit chief's band has gathered at the pass, torches strung in a line.
story.day7_crisis.n2: Two slots remain this week. Use them well; once it ends comes the decisive fight.
story.crisis_final.n1: People of Jade Valley, hand over what you hide and I will spare you!
story.crisis_final.n1_saved: The villagers you saved stand behind you with torches. No one steps back.
story.crisis_final.n2: Night falls, and the decisive fight begins.
ending.valley_sage.title: The Sage of the Valley
ending.valley_sage.body: After the bandits scattered you did not leave Jade Valley. People tell of your technique and your heart, and your companions choose to walk at your side. Years on, children still hear about that night on rainy evenings.
ending.valley_guardian.title: Guardian of Jade Valley
ending.valley_guardian.body: The bandits withdrew, and the villagers you saved came with grain to thank you. You are not the best under heaven, but Jade Valley now has someone to guard it.
ending.lone_victor.title: The Lone Victor
ending.lone_victor.body: You drove off the bandit chief but could not keep the fishing village safe. The valley is grateful, and keeps its distance. Standing at the pass you learn that winning does not mean you are no longer alone.
ending.valley_falls.title: The Valley Falls
ending.valley_falls.body: Firelight swallowed the pass. You gave everything and still could not stop the bandits. But you lived, and led the others into the mountains. The story is not over; it only begins again another way.
ending.faction.pavilion: The Herb Pavilion keeps its sickbeds and furnaces behind you, and after this fight no one in the valley waits to die hungry.
ending.faction.couriers: The couriers carried word out of the mountains, and the name of Jade Valley travelled far on hoofbeats.
ending.faction.scribes: The scribes wrote these years into a book. Later someone reads your name by lamplight.
ending.faction.neutral: You favored no one, so every side is willing to keep a lamp lit for you.
ending.heading: Epilogue
pause.title: Paused

world.area.valley_village.name: Jade Valley Village
world.area.valley_village.desc: Chimney smoke, flagstones and neighbours: where every road begins.
world.area.valley_village.w1: You spend half an hour at the village gate listening to an old man's tales.
world.area.valley_village.w2: Children crowd round for a story at the market; a few coins find your hand.
world.area.valley_village.w3: A cup of hot tea at the stall lets you breathe.
world.area.river_bend.name: Dragon-Return Bend
world.area.river_bend.desc: The stream turns here, and the fish gather.
world.area.river_bend.w1: You gather a few fish stranded in the shallows.
world.area.river_bend.w2: The sound of water settles your mind.
world.area.herb_terraces.name: Herb Terraces
world.area.herb_terraces.desc: Terraced herb beds climb the slope, lushest in spring and summer.
world.area.herb_terraces.w1: You pick a handful of common herbs.
world.area.herb_terraces.w2: The steep path leaves your legs lighter.
world.area.old_shrine.name: Abandoned Mountain Shrine
world.area.old_shrine.desc: The incense died years ago, yet someone still comes and goes.
world.area.old_shrine.w1: The worn stele sets you thinking.
world.area.old_shrine.w2: You sit before the altar a while; your breathing evens out.
world.area.ferry_dock.name: Linjiang Ferry Dock
world.area.ferry_dock.desc: The ferry out of the valley, where news arrives faster than boats.
world.area.ferry_dock.w1: The boatman tells you a few tales of the jianghu.
world.area.ferry_dock.w2: You help carry some cargo and are paid.
event.f_aftermath.1: Two days after the raid the village gate still smells of smoke, and everyone quietly clears the wreckage.
event.f_aftermath.2: "Those were no ordinary bandits," Elder Mo says quietly. "Their blades had schooling. This is not over."
event.f_aftermath.3: I nod and keep the words close.
event.f_gossip.1: "Heard? When they pulled back they went up the rear hill. There've been lights at the shrine at night."
event.f_gossip.2: The shrine… abandoned for years. Worth a look.
event.f_shrine_first.1: Fresh footprints cross the dust before the altar, and two shady figures crouch in a corner.
event.f_shrine_first.c.sneak: Slip away and note what they say
event.f_spring_fair.1: The spring fair opens; coloured cords hang across the lane and traders have come from the next town.
event.f_spring_fair.2: "Come have a bowl of hot soup and share the cheer!"
event.f_spring_fair.3: I help set up stalls all afternoon and come away well paid.
event.f_herb_lesson.1: "Gathering herbs is not weeding," Elder Mo says, crouching. "Know the root, read the season, leave the seed. Those are the rules."
event.f_ferry_rumor.1: The old ferryman lowers his voice: "The ringleader of the shrine crowd rode my boat, headed toward Cangwu."
event.r_village_chat.1: "They say it's rough outside the valley. Take your training seriously."
event.r_village_chat.2: I smile and agree, but the words stick.
event.r_herb_find.1: A rare herb grows bright in a rock crevice.
event.r_fish_tale.1: An old fisherman hands you half a grilled fish: "Young one, the fish are strong where the water runs fast."
event.r_bandit_stray.1: "Halt! Leave your coins!" A straggling bandit leaps from the reeds.
event.r_shrine_dream.1: You doze by the broken wall and dream of an armoured swordsman drilling in the courtyard.
event.r_shrine_dream.2: I wake with my palms oddly warm.
event.r_elder_lesson.1: "Watch the feet before you strike," Elder Mo remarks in passing, and you listen closely.
event.r_winter_frost.1: Frost lies thick as snow; villagers gather round the hearth and invite you to sit.

world.lead.shrine_rumor.desc: Someone moves around the hill shrine at night, perhaps the raiders.
world.lead.ferry_rumor.name: Where the Ferry Went
world.lead.ferry_rumor.desc: The raiders' leader went toward Cangwu; the ferryman may know more.

minigame.fishing.title: Fishing
minigame.fishing.help: Hold to raise the rod, release to let it sink. Keep the fish inside the green bar until the catch meter is full.
realm.first_glimpse.desc: You have just crossed the threshold; every move is still stiff.
realm.entering_hall.desc: Your forms have order and your breathing is steady.
realm.minor_mastery.desc: Among your peers, no one dares look down on you.
realm.integrated.desc: Fists, breath and intent begin to answer one another.
realm.pure_flame.desc: Every move lands exactly as it should.
realm.return_simple.desc: All ornament falls away; only the simplest move remains.
realm.grandmaster.desc: You may found a school of your own.

sheet.life_bonus: Every 3 levels: +1 to the first reward
sheet.bottleneck: Attributes are at the cap: break through to grow further
world.area.old_shrine.m1: Behind the shrine, a hidden niche holds an old booklet: the Wind-Treading Manual.
world.area.herb_terraces.m1: An herb farmer gives you a hand-copied Hundred Herbs Hymn.
world.area.ferry_dock.m1: The old boatman digs out an Iron Sand Palm manual: "It only gathers dust."
world.area.river_bend.m1: An oilcloth bundle in the mud holds a Thunder Palm manual.

tree.none: Choose a school before learning its arts
manual.none: No manuals yet. Explore the world to find some.
manual.group_taken: You already follow a manual of this kind
manual.hint: Only one manual of each kind can be studied.

event.arc_shen_qinghe_1.title: The Old Prescription
event.arc_shen_qinghe_1.1: Shen Qinghe spreads a yellowed prescription across the basket lid, a fingertip resting beside the last herb. "My master wrote this just before falling ill."
event.arc_shen_qinghe_1.2: "The prescription is sound. The bowl he drank was not." She looks up. "Will you help me find out?"
event.arc_shen_qinghe_1.3: I nod. "Whatever you need, just ask."
event.arc_shen_qinghe_2.title: The Master's Sickbed
event.arc_shen_qinghe_2.1: In the hillside cottage the medicine smells bitter and thick. The old man lies still, his breathing barely stirring the blanket.
event.arc_shen_qinghe_2.2: "There is something in the dregs that should not be," Shen Qinghe says quietly. "A secret medicine only the Accord uses."
event.arc_shen_qinghe_2.3: I help her sort the dregs bit by bit until the light goes.
event.arc_shen_qinghe_3.title: The Accord's Secret Medicine
event.arc_shen_qinghe_3.1: "I traced the secret medicine," Shen Qinghe says, twisting her sleeve. "If I expose it, the Accord will hunt me. If I stay silent, my master gets no cure."
event.arc_shen_qinghe_3.c.open: Urge her to tell the truth
event.arc_shen_qinghe_3.c.quiet: Help her find the cure in secret
event.arc_shen_qinghe_3.c.leave: Tell her to protect herself and let go
event.arc_shen_qinghe_4.title: Moonlit Herb Beds
event.arc_shen_qinghe_4.1: The herb beds are so quiet at night that dew can be heard falling. Shen Qinghe sits on the ridge, looking up at the moon.
event.arc_shen_qinghe_4.2: "Thank you, for all of this," she smiles. "What would you like to be to me?"
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_1.title: The Unsigned Letter
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_1.1: On the ferry steps of the Bend, Lu Chenzhou crouches over an unsigned letter, unusually serious.
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_1.2: "I'm a courier. I never open letters," he says, turning it over. "But I know this handwriting, and the man died three years ago."
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_1.3: I look at the letter. "Then who sent it?"
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_2.title: Chasing the Letter
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_2.1: "Someone wants this letter," Lu Chenzhou says, keeping his voice low. "My pack was searched last night, and today I was followed."
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_2.2: "Stop! Hand over the letter!" Figures burst from the reeds.
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_2.c.slip: Pull him round a back path
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_3.title: What the Letter Said
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_3.1: The letter is open. Inside is a ledger proving a ferry-side bigwig sold out his comrades. Lu Chenzhou stares at it, silent.
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_3.2: "Someone offered ten times my fee for it," he says softly. "I have never seen so much money."
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_3.c.deliver: Urge him to give it to someone who will see justice done
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_3.c.burn: Burn it, so both sides can step down
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_3.c.sell: Let him go; the money is real
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_4.title: Night Talk at the Ferry
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_4.1: The night ferry is empty, its lantern drawing a long streak of light on the water.
event.arc_lu_chenzhou_4.2: "You ask what I'd like to be to you?" Lu Chenzhou scratches his head. "I've thought about all of it."
event.arc_bai_yan_1.title: Rubbings of the Broken Stele
event.arc_bai_yan_1.1: Bai Yan lays a stack of rubbings on the altar, ink drowning the smell of dust. "The stele does not hold prayers. It holds a fragment of a manual."
event.arc_bai_yan_1.2: "A manual? Who carves martial arts on a shrine stele?"
event.arc_bai_yan_1.3: "Someone who wanted it hidden." He nudges the lamp closer. "I want to finish reading it."
event.arc_bai_yan_2.title: Hidden Marks in the Rubbings
event.arc_bai_yan_2.1: "Look here," Bai Yan says, pointing between the strokes. "Another script hides in the gaps."
event.arc_bai_yan_2.2: We trace stroke by stroke beside the lamp until the oil runs dry.
event.arc_bai_yan_3.title: Knowledge and Danger
event.arc_bai_yan_3.1: The fragment is read through. It records a technique that can unhinge a mind, the very thing the Accord has long sought.
event.arc_bai_yan_3.2: "Publish it and people will bleed for it; destroy it and one possibility vanishes from the world." Bai Yan looks at you. "What do you think?"
event.arc_bai_yan_3.c.share: Urge him to publish the first half so people know its harm
event.arc_bai_yan_3.c.keep: Keep one copy, in his own hands
event.arc_bai_yan_3.c.burn: Urge him to burn the rubbings
event.arc_bai_yan_4.title: Lamp in the Shrine
event.arc_bai_yan_4.1: The lamp burns quietly as Bai Yan sorts the last page of notes.
event.arc_bai_yan_4.2: "These days you taught me something: some things count without being understood." He looks up. "What would you be to me?"
arc.gate.stage: Earlier chapters of the story come first
world.area.bamboo_pass.name: Bamboo Pass
world.area.bamboo_pass.desc: The one road out of the valley, bamboo rising on both sides.
world.area.bamboo_pass.w1: Leaves whisper as you drill a few footwork patterns along the road.
world.area.bamboo_pass.w2: A bamboo cutter presses two hot flatbreads into your hands.
world.area.lj_docks.name: Linjiang Docks
world.area.lj_docks.desc: A forest of masts; chanting rises from dawn to midnight.
world.area.lj_docks.w1: You haul a few crates and the foreman tosses you a handful of coins.
world.area.lj_docks.w2: An old boatman teaches you to read ripples, and you pick up the trick.
world.area.lj_market.name: Linjiang Market
world.area.lj_market.desc: Shouts, aromas and bells packed into a single street.
world.area.lj_market.w1: A stallkeeper gives you a honey cake: "luck of the passerby."
world.area.lj_market.w2: You mind a stall for an afternoon and earn a few coppers.
world.area.lj_teahouse.name: Clear-Heart Teahouse
world.area.lj_teahouse.desc: The upstairs seats hold all sorts; one pot of tea buys a day of rumours.
world.area.lj_teahouse.w1: The storyteller at the next table reaches the good part and you lose yourself in it.
world.area.lj_teahouse.w2: The owner lets you taste a new tea.
world.area.lj_escort.name: Pingyuan Escort Bureau
world.area.lj_escort.desc: A pair of stone lions guard the gate; someone is always drilling inside.
world.area.lj_escort.w1: The escorts let you spar a few rounds.
world.area.lj_escort.w2: The bookkeeper asks you to carry a letter and tips you a few coins.
world.area.lj_pawn.name: Ten-Thousand-Treasures Pawnshop
world.area.lj_pawn.desc: The counter is taller than a man and the keeper's eye truer than his scales.
world.area.lj_pawn.w1: You find some usable ore in an old crate in a corner.
world.area.lj_pawn.w2: In idle talk the keeper mentions a few old rumours of the martial world.
world.area.lj_alleys.name: Night Alleys
world.area.lj_alleys.desc: Empty by day; lamps only after dark.
world.area.lj_alleys.w1: You watch a gambling game from the shadows and learn to read faces.
world.area.lj_alleys.w2: A stray cat leads you around a night patrol.
event.q1_tally.title: Half a Tally
event.q1_tally.1: That night Elder Mo stokes the fire and takes a half-cut jade tally from the bottom of a chest, laying it in your palm.
event.q1_tally.2: "This was wrapped in your blanket the day you were brought here. Where the other half lies I do not know. But the men who raided the valley were looking for it."
event.q1_tally.3: "Jade Valley was once the 'ninth house'. I have kept that secret for you all my life."
event.q1_tally.c.ask: Keep the tally and ask about the 'ninth house'
event.q1_tally.c.rest: Put it away; ask another day
event.q1_bamboo.title: Ambush on the Bamboo Road
event.q1_bamboo.1: At the end of the bamboo road a masked rider reins in, two guards behind him. A Barge Guild wooden token hangs at his belt.
event.q1_bamboo.2: "Valley kid, leave the half tally and we will call today a day we never met."
event.ry1_bamboo_mist.title: Morning in the Bamboo
event.ry1_bamboo_mist.1: Morning mist seals the bamboo road, so you drill a set of forms in it and come out with a damp collar.
event.ry1_bamboo_cutter.title: The Bamboo Cutter
event.ry1_bamboo_cutter.1: The bamboo cutter wipes his brow: "Plenty of strangers on the road lately. Keep your eyes open."
event.ry1_bend_heron.title: Heron in the Shallows
event.ry1_bend_heron.1: A heron stands motionless in the shallows. You watch it so long that you glimpse something of stillness.
event.q2_arrival.title: First Steps in Linjiang
event.q2_arrival.1: Linjiang's docks are ten times bigger than you imagined. You have barely stepped off the boat when a self-styled 'guide' blocks the way.
event.q2_arrival.2: "Outsider, the 'safe-passage fee' first. Three taels and nothing happens to you."
event.q2_arrival.c.wit: Argue loudly until the watch comes
event.q2_qian_man.title: Qian Man's Counter
event.q2_qian_man.1: Behind the counter Qian Man does not look up: "From Jade Valley? The one with half a jade?"
event.q2_qian_man.2: My stomach tightens. "How do you know?"
event.q2_qian_man.3: "In Linjiang there is nothing I do not know, only prices I do not care to sell at. The escort bureau is short of hands. Go there; you may hear what you want."
event.q2_su_dai.title: Pipa at the Market
event.q2_su_dai.1: A crowd circles a corner of the market. A girl with a pipa on her back plays and sings, bells chiming with the beat.
event.q2_su_dai.2: "You there, you have listened to my song. If not a tip then at least leave a name?"
event.q2_su_dai.3: I give my name, and her eyes crinkle with her smile. "I am Su Dai. Next time I will sing you a new one."
event.arc_su_dai_1.title: The Song That Hides a Map
event.arc_su_dai_1.1: "My mother left me this song," Su Dai says quietly. "But I keep feeling the words hide something else."
event.arc_su_dai_1.2: "Listen: 'Cross the bridge at the third watch, seek the star against the current.' Who sings a song that specific?"
event.arc_su_dai_1.3: I think of the tally and the Nine Stars and feel a stir. "Perhaps it is a map."
event.q2_dragon_boat.title: Dragon-Boat Day
event.q2_dragon_boat.1: The Dragon-Boat Festival has come: drums thunder over the river, the long boats line up, and both banks are packed.
event.q2_dragon_boat.2: "One paddler short! Who will join? Win the prize and we all share!"
event.q2_dragon_boat.c.watch: Watch from the bank and buy snacks
event.q2_li_shan.title: The Burned Smithy
event.q2_li_shan.1: At the end of the docks stands a blackened smithy, only half a furnace left. A huge man crouches in the ashes, searching.
event.q2_li_shan.2: "Nothing... sold here any more." He looks up, voice low. "Somebody burned the forge."
event.q2_li_shan.3: I crouch and help him dig through the rubble.
event.arc_li_shan_1.title: Lighting the Furnace Again
event.arc_li_shan_1.1: "This iron did not burn by itself," Li Shan says, pinching a pale slag. "Someone poured oil in the furnace. They wanted the ledger burned, and the ore."
event.arc_li_shan_1.2: "I want to light this furnace again. I need ore, and... someone willing to help."
event.arc_li_shan_1.c.sift: Help him sift ashes for the ledger
event.arc_li_shan_1.c.ore: Leave some ore and a promise
event.q2_escort.title: Escort North
event.q2_escort.1: The head of Pingyuan Escort Bureau claps your shoulder: "Friend, a consignment goes north along the trade road. It is not safe. Will you ride along?"
event.q2_escort.2: Halfway along the road, figures leap out of the trees.
event.q2_escort.c.detour: Take a back path and avoid the clash
event.q2_barge_guild.title: The Alley Warehouse
event.q2_barge_guild.1: Beneath the cargo crates a tiny anchor is carved: the Barge Guild's mark.
event.q2_barge_guild.2: You follow the mark into the deep alleys. Lamplight leaks from the door of an unremarkable warehouse.
event.q2_barge_guild.c.sneak: Sneak in and read the ledgers
event.q2_fragment.title: The First Star
event.q2_fragment.1: The Barge Guild master sits in a prow, slowly rubbing a dark stone shard. "I hear you are looking for this."
event.q2_fragment.2: "It is the first fragment of the Nine Stars. I can let you study it, on one condition: from now on you protect the guild's boats."
event.q2_fragment.c.refuse: Decline, and find your own way
event.ry1_dock_porter.title: Soup on the Dock
event.ry1_dock_porter.1: A porter hands you a bowl of hot soup with a grin: "New here? Rest up, Linjiang's work never ends."
event.ry1_dock_fisher.title: Fishing off the Pier
event.ry1_dock_fisher.1: An old fisherman by the pier teaches you to read the waterline and find the fish.
event.ry1_market_haggle.title: Haggling
event.ry1_market_haggle.1: You bargain on behalf of an old woman, and she shares half the savings with you.
event.ry1_market_acrobat.title: Tumblers on a Rope
event.ry1_market_acrobat.1: Street acrobats tumble on a rope; you watch, and glimpse something about balance.
event.ry1_tea_gossip.title: Teahouse Talk
event.ry1_tea_gossip.1: People at the next table chat about the sects' recent moves; you listen quietly for half an hour.
event.ry1_escort_drill.title: Escort Drill
event.ry1_escort_drill.1: The escorts are drilling the 'Three Talents' formation and pull you in to fill a corner.
event.ry1_pawn_curio.title: A Trinket on the Counter
event.ry1_pawn_curio.1: Qian Man lazily pushes over a small iron plate: "A trinket. No charge."
event.ry1_alley_cat.title: The Alley Cat
event.ry1_alley_cat.1: In the night alleys a stray cat leads you around a few drunks.
ability.soothing_tune.desc: A tune that restores an ally's resolve.
ability.bell_strike.desc: Bells that rattle the enemy and weaken them.
ability.pipa_crescendo.desc: Bond ability (once per battle, no action): restores 8 HP and resolve to an ally within range 3.
ability.hammer_blow.desc: A heavy blow that knocks the enemy back a cell.
ability.iron_taunt.desc: Presence that weighs on the enemy and weakens them.
ability.forge_oath.desc: Bond ability (once per battle, no action): restores 12 HP and 6 resolve to an ally within range 2.
companion.su_dai.bio: A street musician with a pipa on her back who helps through song. Loves a crowd and a good story.
companion.li_shan.bio: A quiet smith, strong as an ox, who shields his friends. The forge is his one subject.
world.lead.linjiang_token.name: The Guild Token
world.lead.linjiang_token.desc: The Barge Guild token at the rider's belt may lead you to answers in Linjiang.
world.lead.escort_job.name: The Escort Job
world.lead.escort_job.desc: Qian Man says the escort bureau needs hands. Try Pingyuan.
world.lead.barge_trail.name: The Anchor Mark
world.lead.barge_trail.desc: A Barge Guild anchor is carved under the crates.
world.lead.fragment_one.name: The Alley Warehouse
world.lead.fragment_one.desc: The guild keeps a warehouse in the alleys, perhaps hiding the first star.
world.lead.fragment_traced.name: The First Star
world.lead.fragment_traced.desc: The first fragment of the Nine Stars has been traced.
world.lead.song_map.name: Su Dai's Song
world.lead.song_map.desc: The song's verses seem to hide a route.
world.lead.burned_forge.name: The Burned Forge
world.lead.burned_forge.desc: Li Shan's smithy was burned on purpose, and it has to do with a lot of ore.
world.lead.tea_rumor.name: Teahouse Rumours
world.lead.tea_rumor.desc: The teahouse buzzes with news of the sects.
world.area.cw_gate.name: Cangwu Gate Steps
world.area.cw_gate.desc: Nine hundred stone steps climb into cloud, guarded by old pines.
world.area.cw_gate.w1: You climb the steps one by one; the legs ache but the mind settles.
world.area.cw_gate.w2: A gate disciple sees your manners and passes on a few house rules.
world.area.cw_courts.name: Training Courts
world.area.cw_courts.desc: Blue-stone courts where disciples spar from dawn.
world.area.cw_courts.w1: You watch half an hour of sparring from the edge.
world.area.cw_courts.w2: A senior brother trades a few moves and hands you a flask of water.
world.area.cw_library.name: Scripture Library
world.area.cw_library.desc: Three storeys of timber, ink and old paper mingled.
world.area.cw_library.w1: In a corner you find a damaged copy of the Pine-Wind Notes.
world.area.cw_library.w2: The old keeper asks you to air the books and tips you a few coins.
world.area.cw_cave.name: Cliff Cave
world.area.cw_cave.desc: A natural cave halfway up the cliff, once a place of seclusion.
world.area.cw_cave.w1: The cave is bitterly cold; you sit in the dark for a while.
world.area.cw_cave.w2: A few glinting ore chunks sit in the rock crevices.
world.area.cw_spring.name: Hot Spring
world.area.cw_spring.desc: A natural hot spring on the slope, steaming; disciples come here to mend.
world.area.cw_spring.w1: A soak in the spring melts the tiredness out of you.
world.area.cw_spring.w2: Voices murmur in the steam; you catch a few words and leave.
event.q3_invitation.title: The Cangwu Invitation
event.q3_invitation.1: A teahouse waiter hands you an invitation stamped with a pine crest: "Cangwu School invites young talents to its triennial tournament."
event.q3_invitation.2: At the bottom is a line in small characters: "Please bring the half tally."
event.q3_invitation.3: How do they know about the tally? I tuck the invitation away.
event.q3_gate_steps.title: The Gate Trial
event.q3_gate_steps.1: Before the gate a stern man stands with hands behind his back. "I am Gu Xingzhou. Cangwu has one rule: once you climb, learn first to wait."
event.q3_gate_steps.2: "Admission trial: nine hundred steps in one breath, no help allowed."
event.q3_gate_steps.c.steady: Steady the breath, one step at a time
event.q3_library.title: Old Scrolls in the Library
event.q3_library.1: On the library's second floor Bai Yan is bent over a copying desk, one sleeve stained with ink.
event.q3_library.2: "Ah, you came too! The collection is bigger than I imagined, and more dangerous." He lowers his voice. "Someone has tampered with the Nine-Star files."
event.q3_library.3: I help him list the suspicious files one by one.
event.q3_xie_wujiu.title: The Dark-Red Spear
event.q3_xie_wujiu.1: At the edge of the courts a young man in a faded dark-red robe leans on a long spear, watching the bouts coldly. Disciples step around him as they pass.
event.q3_xie_wujiu.2: "New? You did well on the gate trial." He raises an eyebrow. "Care to trade a few moves? I am not here to be polite."
event.arc_xie_wujiu_1.title: The Wrong of Three Years Ago
event.arc_xie_wujiu_1.1: "I was Cangwu's youngest inner disciple," Xie Wujiu says, gazing at the distant pines. "Three years ago something vanished from the library, and everyone said I took it."
event.arc_xie_wujiu_1.2: "I did not. But I cannot find proof." His grip tightens on the shaft. "Whether you believe me, I do not care."
event.arc_xie_wujiu_1.3: I look into his eyes. "I believe you. If you want, I will help you look."
event.q3_mid_autumn.title: Mid-Autumn Night
event.q3_mid_autumn.1: On Mid-Autumn night lanterns hang in the pines by the spring, disciples and guests sitting round to watch the moon.
event.q3_mid_autumn.2: The moon climbs high, and you wonder whom to sit with.
event.q3_tournament_1.title: Tournament: First Round
event.q3_tournament_1.1: On the platform Gu Xingzhou announces: "First round, two against two. Winners advance."
event.q3_tournament_1.2: Two disciples across the ring salute, their eyes anything but soft.
event.q3_tournament_2.title: Tournament: Second Round
event.q3_tournament_2.1: "Second round. Three against three; once the drum sounds, no stopping."
event.q3_tournament_3.title: Tournament: The Final
event.q3_tournament_3.1: "The final." Gu Xingzhou gestures at the silent senior in the ring. "The strongest outer disciple in ten years. Win or lose, it is an honour."
event.q3_theft.title: The Theft
event.q3_theft.1: The tournament has barely ended when a cry rises from the library: the pine-wind score that guards the hall is gone.
event.q3_theft.2: "Who was last in the loft?" Every disciple's eyes turn to Xie Wujiu in the corner.
event.q3_theft.3: "Me again?" He sneers. "You have never once changed your line."
event.q3_theft.c.public: Stand up for him in public
event.q3_theft.c.quiet: Quietly look into it for him
event.q3_hui_mask.title: The Grey Mask
event.q3_hui_mask.1: Deep in the cliff cave a figure in a grey mask stands with his back to you before the rock wall.
event.q3_hui_mask.2: "Child of Jade Valley." He does not turn. "The less you know, the safer you are. Go back."
event.q3_hui_mask.3: I want to press him, but he dissolves into the dark like smoke.
event.ry3_gate_pines.title: Sweeping Leaves
event.ry3_gate_pines.1: Beneath an old pine a monk sweeps leaves. He smiles and hands you a bamboo broom.
event.ry3_courts_spar.title: Sparring Partner
event.ry3_courts_spar.1: A disciple invites you to spar: "Do not hold back!"
event.ry3_courts_drill.title: Thirteen Pine-Wave Forms
event.ry3_courts_drill.1: To drumbeats the disciples drill the Thirteen Pine-Wave Forms, and you follow at the tail.
event.ry3_library_read.title: A Book on Breath
event.ry3_library_read.1: You find an old book on breathing and read it through the afternoon.
event.ry3_library_keeper.title: Footsteps at Night
event.ry3_library_keeper.1: The old keeper murmurs: "Lately there are footsteps in the hall at night."
event.ry3_cave_echo.title: Echo in the Cave
event.ry3_cave_echo.1: The cave's echo runs long; you call into the dark and listen to it recede.
event.ry3_spring_soak.title: A Rest by the Spring
event.ry3_spring_soak.1: The spring is warm; you close your eyes and listen to the pines.
event.ry3_spring_gossip.title: Talk by the Spring
event.ry3_spring_gossip.1: Two senior sisters chat as they soak: "They say the master has other plans for this tournament."
combat.scenario.xie_duel.objective: Defeat the disciple Xie sets against you.
ability.spear_sweep.desc: A sweeping spear that knocks the enemy back.
ability.spear_oath.desc: Bond ability (once per battle, no action): an extra strike within range 2.
companion.xie_wujiu.bio: A prodigy cast out of Cangwu, sharp with the spear, cold outside and warm within.
world.lead.cangwu_invite.name: The Cangwu Invitation
world.lead.cangwu_invite.desc: Cangwu School invites you to its tournament and asks for the half tally.
world.lead.library_files.name: Tampered Files
world.lead.library_files.desc: Someone has tampered with the Nine-Star files in the library.
world.lead.frame_whisper.name: Xie Wujiu's Wrong
world.lead.frame_whisper.desc: A theft three years ago was pinned on Xie Wujiu; he says he is innocent.
world.lead.theft_clue.name: The Stolen Pine Score
world.lead.theft_clue.desc: The pine-wind score is stolen again, and Xie Wujiu is the suspect once more.
world.lead.hui_mask_seen.name: The Grey Mask
world.lead.hui_mask_seen.desc: A grey-masked man in the cliff cave knows you come from Jade Valley.
world.lead.library_footsteps.name: Footsteps in the Library
world.lead.library_footsteps.desc: Footsteps sound in the library at night, perhaps connected to the theft.
world.area.ms_flats.name: Fishing Flats
world.area.ms_flats.desc: Shallows and mudflats run together; oars knock somewhere in the fog.
world.area.ms_flats.w1: You sit at the flats half a day and land a few fat fish.
world.area.ms_flats.w2: Someone's footprints cross the mud; you follow them a while.
world.area.ms_reeds.name: Reed Maze
world.area.ms_reeds.desc: Reeds taller than a man; one turn and the way back is lost.
world.area.ms_reeds.w1: You read the wind among the reeds and slowly pick a way.
world.area.ms_reeds.w2: A few ore chunks, washed out by the water, lie hidden in the reeds.
world.area.ms_temple.name: Sunken Star Temple
world.area.ms_temple.desc: A stone temple half-sunk in water, its walls carved with star charts.
world.area.ms_temple.w1: You study the star charts on the broken walls for a long time.
world.area.ms_temple.w2: The temple is eerily quiet; you use it to steady your breath.
event.q4_marsh_rumor.title: Rumors of the Marsh
event.q4_marsh_rumor.1: Boatmen at the docks mutter: "In the Sunken-Star Marsh a light climbs from the water to the sky every night."
event.q4_marsh_rumor.2: The tally warms faintly in my coat. Perhaps it is time to look.
event.q4_ferryman.title: The Old Ferryman
event.q4_ferryman.1: At the end of the flats an old man poles a small boat: "Only the stars know the way to the temple. How do you ask?"
event.q4_ferryman.2: "Do you listen to the water, or watch the sky?"
event.q4_reeds.title: The Reed Maze
event.q4_reeds.1: Fog rises among the reeds. Someone calls your name nearby, familiar but not quite right.
event.q4_reeds.2: I stop and try to place where the voice is coming from.
event.q4_reeds.c.mark: Bend reeds to mark the way
event.q4_solstice.title: Winter Solstice
event.q4_solstice.1: On Winter Solstice night every house steams dumplings and the shrine lamp is lit.
event.q4_solstice.2: Elder Mo hands you a hot bowl. "However far you go, come home for the feast."
event.q4_solstice.3: Whom do you want to share the bowl with?
event.q4_temple.title: The Sunken Temple
event.q4_temple.1: Deep in the temple a stone door is set into the wall. The tally burns warm and starlight seeps through the seam.
event.q4_temple.2: The door stays shut. But one star on the carved chart lights up.
event.q4_temple.3: The first star... so this is the Nine-Star Gate.
event.q4_ambush.title: Ambush on the Flats
event.q4_ambush.1: On the flats back, a dozen grey-clad figures rise from the reeds. Their captain sneers: "Leave the tally and you may walk."
event.q4_ambush.2: These are the Gate's probes. I clench my fists.
event.q4_elder_fork.title: Elder Mo's Fate
event.q4_elder_fork.live.1: You are back. I never let the lamp at the gate go out.
event.q4_elder_fork.live.2: The village is safe and so are you. For the first time in years I slept soundly.
event.q4_elder_fork.live.3: I will keep Jade Valley. You go and walk your road.
event.q4_elder_fork.retire.1: You won, but the village lost someone.
event.q4_elder_fork.retire.2: I cannot hold this place any more. Let me follow you; these old bones can still give counsel.
event.q4_elder_fork.fall.1: By the time you reach Jade Valley, the lamp before the shrine has gone out.
event.q4_elder_fork.fall.2: Elder Mo leans in the doorway and presses an old seal into your hand: "Do not look back. The Nine Stars are more than one gate."
event.ry4_flats_fish.title: A Quiet Cast
event.ry4_flats_fish.1: The float dips and you lift a fat fish.
event.ry4_flats_mist.title: Oars in the Mist
event.ry4_flats_mist.1: Oars sound in the mist but no boat appears.
event.ry4_reeds_birds.title: Startled Egrets
event.ry4_reeds_birds.1: Egrets burst from the reeds and you follow where they fly.
event.ry4_reeds_ore.title: Ore in the Mud
event.ry4_reeds_ore.1: Your boot strikes something hard in the mud: ore.
event.ry4_temple_chart.title: Tracing the Chart
event.ry4_temple_chart.1: You trace the chart's lines on your palm over and over.
event.ry4_temple_rest.title: A Rest in the Temple
event.ry4_temple_rest.1: The temple steps are dry; you sit and rest.
world.lead.marsh_open.name: The Sunken-Star Marsh
world.lead.marsh_open.desc: Rumor says starlight rises from the Sunken-Star Marsh each night.
world.lead.temple_path.name: The Way to the Temple
world.lead.temple_path.desc: The old ferryman has shown the way to the sunken temple.
world.lead.vault_gate.name: The Nine-Star Gate
world.lead.vault_gate.desc: The temple's stone door answered the tally and one star lit.
world.lead.elder_advisor.name: Elder Mo Travels With You
world.lead.elder_advisor.desc: Elder Mo has laid down the village watch and travels with you as an advisor.
world.lead.elder_seal_lead.name: Elder Mo's Seal
world.lead.elder_seal_lead.desc: Elder Mo left an old seal; the valley's future is yours to decide.
